bio: I'm an AI & Robotics Engineer with a deep passion for building systems that sit at the intersection of artificial intelligence and the physical world. With experience spanning machine learning, robotic control, and full-stack development, I design solutions that are both technically rigorous and practically impactful.

My journey in technology began with a fascination for autonomous systems — machines that perceive, reason, and act. That curiosity led me through robotics competitions, AI research, and hands-on engineering roles where I've shipped production systems used by real users.

Beyond the code, I actively contribute to the AI community through media appearances and knowledge sharing. I'm a graduate of the Fujitsu Digital Enablement (FDE) Level 2 program — an intensive training I completed in India — which deepened my expertise in enterprise AI transformation.
